trans-unit.resname: A new module version is available.
trans-unit.source: A new module version is available.

trans-unit.resname: Adds a withdrawal entry to the customer’s My account area. The customer is still allowed to use the public flow when the order is not visible in the account.
trans-unit.source: Adds a withdrawal entry to the customer’s My account area. The customer is still allowed to use the public flow when the order is not visible in the account.
trans-unit.target: Prideda sutarties atsisakymo punktą kliento srityje „Mano paskyra“. Klientas vis tiek gali naudoti viešą procesą, kai užsakymas paskyroje nematomas.

trans-unit.resname: Adds a “Withdraw from contract” button to the detail of an order owned by the signed-in customer. Ownership is checked on the server.
trans-unit.source: Adds a “Withdraw from contract” button to the detail of an order owned by the signed-in customer. Ownership is checked on the server.
trans-unit.target: Prideda mygtuką „Atsisakyti sutarties“ prie prisijungusiam klientui priklausančio užsakymo informacijos. Nuosavybė tikrinama serveryje.

trans-unit.resname: Allows the consumer to submit an unequivocal withdrawal without signing in or displaying order data. Keep this function available for applicable online B2C contracts.
trans-unit.source: Allows the consumer to submit an unequivocal withdrawal without signing in or displaying order data. Keep this function available for applicable online B2C contracts.
trans-unit.target: Leidžia vartotojui pateikti nedviprasmišką sutarties atsisakymo pareiškimą neprisijungus ir nerodant užsakymo duomenų. Palikite funkciją prieinamą taikomoms internetinėms B2C sutartims.

trans-unit.resname: Attaches the immutable withdrawal confirmation PDF to the acknowledgement email. Disabling the attachment does not remove the protected PDF stored with the case.
trans-unit.source: Attaches the immutable withdrawal confirmation PDF to the acknowledgement email. Disabling the attachment does not remove the protected PDF stored with the case.
trans-unit.target: Prideda nekeičiamą sutarties atsisakymo PDF patvirtinimą prie patvirtinimo el. laiško. Išjungus priedą, su byla saugomas apsaugotas PDF nepašalinamas.

trans-unit.resname: Customer-facing contact address for withdrawal communication. Use an actively monitored mailbox; do not enter the customer’s email here.
trans-unit.source: Customer-facing contact address for withdrawal communication. Use an actively monitored mailbox; do not enter the customer’s email here.
trans-unit.target: Klientui rodomas kontaktinis adresas bendravimui dėl sutarties atsisakymo. Naudokite aktyviai stebimą pašto dėžutę; čia neįveskite kliento el. pašto adreso.

trans-unit.resname: Displays the customer-facing “Withdraw from contract here” link in the shop footer. This legal-function link is independent of the Joobox marketing attribution.
trans-unit.source: Displays the customer-facing “Withdraw from contract here” link in the shop footer. This legal-function link is independent of the Joobox marketing attribution.
trans-unit.target: Parduotuvės poraštėje rodo klientui skirtą nuorodą „Atsisakyti sutarties čia“. Ši teisinės funkcijos nuoroda nepriklauso nuo „Joobox“ rinkodaros nuorodos.

trans-unit.resname: Each active shop language receives its own localized friendly path. The language-neutral entry URLs remain available for external link-list modules. Test both flows in every active language after deployment.
trans-unit.source: Each active shop language receives its own localized friendly path. The language-neutral entry URLs remain available for external link-list modules. Test both flows in every active language after deployment.
trans-unit.target: Kiekviena aktyvi parduotuvės kalba gauna savo lokalizuotą aiškų kelią. Nuo kalbos nepriklausomi įėjimo URL lieka prieinami išoriniams nuorodų sąrašo moduliams. Įdiegę išbandykite abu procesus kiekviena aktyvia kalba.

trans-unit.resname: Enables the direct online withdrawal form that does not require a customer account or access to the original order email. Disable it only after a market-specific legal review.
trans-unit.source: Enables the direct online withdrawal form that does not require a customer account or access to the original order email. Disable it only after a market-specific legal review.
trans-unit.target: Įjungia tiesioginę internetinę sutarties atsisakymo formą, kuriai nereikia kliento paskyros ar prieigos prie pradinio užsakymo el. laiško. Išjunkite tik atlikę konkrečios rinkos teisinę peržiūrą.

trans-unit.resname: Ends a verified guest session after this period without activity. Expected range: 5–240 minutes; recommended default: 30.
trans-unit.source: Ends a verified guest session after this period without activity. Expected range: 5–240 minutes; recommended default: 30.
trans-unit.target: Po šio neaktyvumo laikotarpio nutraukia patvirtintą svečio seansą. Tikėtinas intervalas: 5–240 minučių; rekomenduojama numatytoji reikšmė: 30.

trans-unit.resname: Enter the absolute HTTPS URL of the privacy policy that explains processing of personal data for receiving and handling withdrawals.
trans-unit.source: Enter the absolute HTTPS URL of the privacy policy that explains processing of personal data for receiving and handling withdrawals.
trans-unit.target: Įveskite absoliutų privatumo politikos HTTPS URL, kuriame paaiškinamas asmens duomenų tvarkymas priimant ir nagrinėjant sutarties atsisakymus.

trans-unit.resname: Enter the exact address and practical instructions for returning goods. These instructions must not impose conditions that unlawfully restrict the consumer’s withdrawal right.
trans-unit.source: Enter the exact address and practical instructions for returning goods. These instructions must not impose conditions that unlawfully restrict the consumer’s withdrawal right.
trans-unit.target: Įveskite tikslų prekių grąžinimo adresą ir praktinius nurodymus. Nurodymai negali nustatyti sąlygų, neteisėtai ribojančių vartotojo teisę atsisakyti sutarties.

trans-unit.resname: Enter the identifier required in the seller’s jurisdiction, for example company ID, VAT ID or commercial-register number.
trans-unit.source: Enter the identifier required in the seller’s jurisdiction, for example company ID, VAT ID or commercial-register number.
trans-unit.target: Įveskite pardavėjo jurisdikcijoje reikalaujamą identifikatorių, pavyzdžiui, įmonės kodą, PVM mokėtojo kodą ar komercinio registro numerį.

trans-unit.resname: Enter the seller’s full legal or registered business name, not the module vendor. It appears in the form, acknowledgement email and PDF.
trans-unit.source: Enter the seller’s full legal or registered business name, not the module vendor. It appears in the form, acknowledgement email and PDF.
trans-unit.target: Įveskite visą juridinį arba registruotą pardavėjo pavadinimą, o ne modulio tiekėjo pavadinimą. Jis rodomas formoje, patvirtinimo el. laiške ir PDF.

trans-unit.resname: Enter the seller’s registered office or business address exactly as it should appear in the consumer document.
trans-unit.source: Enter the seller’s registered office or business address exactly as it should appear in the consumer document.
trans-unit.target: Įveskite pardavėjo registruotos buveinės arba veiklos adresą tiksliai taip, kaip jis turi būti rodomas vartotojo dokumente.

trans-unit.resname: Footer link (keep enabled for applicable online B2C contracts)
trans-unit.source: Footer link (keep enabled for applicable online B2C contracts)
trans-unit.target: Nuoroda poraštėje (palikite įjungtą taikomoms internetinėms B2C sutartims)

trans-unit.resname: For applicable B2C distance contracts concluded through an online interface, disabling or hiding the direct withdrawal function may conflict with Article 11a of Directive 2011/83/EU as amended by Directive (EU) 2023/2673. National implementation must still be reviewed for each market.
trans-unit.source: For applicable B2C distance contracts concluded through an online interface, disabling or hiding the direct withdrawal function may conflict with Article 11a of Directive 2011/83/EU as amended by Directive (EU) 2023/2673. National implementation must still be reviewed for each market.
trans-unit.target: Taikomų B2C nuotolinių sutarčių, sudarytų naudojant internetinę sąsają, atveju tiesioginės sutarties atsisakymo funkcijos išjungimas ar slėpimas gali prieštarauti Direktyvos 2011/83/ES 11a straipsniui, iš dalies pakeistam Direktyva (ES) 2023/2673. Vis tiek reikia patikrinti nacionalinį įgyvendinimą kiekvienoje rinkoje.

trans-unit.resname: For PrestaShop installation, do not use GitHub automatic "Source code ZIP". Use only the installation ZIP file from the release assets.
trans-unit.source: For PrestaShop installation, do not use GitHub automatic "Source code ZIP". Use only the installation ZIP file from the release assets.
trans-unit.target: Diegdami „PrestaShop“ nenaudokite automatinio „GitHub“ failo „Source code ZIP“. Naudokite tik diegimo ZIP iš leidimo išteklių.

trans-unit.resname: GitHub checks are performed at most once every six hours unless manually refreshed. The module never downloads or installs code automatically.
trans-unit.source: GitHub checks are performed at most once every six hours unless manually refreshed. The module never downloads or installs code automatically.
trans-unit.target: „GitHub“ tikrinama ne dažniau kaip kartą per šešias valandas, nebent atnaujinama rankiniu būdu. Modulis niekada automatiškai neatsisiunčia ir neįdiegia kodo.

trans-unit.resname: How long the one-time email access link remains usable. Expected range: 5–240 minutes; recommended default: 30.
trans-unit.source: How long the one-time email access link remains usable. Expected range: 5–240 minutes; recommended default: 30.
trans-unit.target: Kiek laiko galima naudoti vienkartinę el. pašto prieigos nuorodą. Tikėtinas intervalas: 5–240 minučių; rekomenduojama numatytoji reikšmė: 30.

trans-unit.resname: Language-neutral URLs for external link lists:
trans-unit.source: Language-neutral URLs for external link lists:
trans-unit.target: Nuo kalbos nepriklausomi URL išoriniams nuorodų sąrašams:

trans-unit.resname: Master switch for the public withdrawal flows and customer-facing withdrawal links. Disabling it does not delete or alter withdrawals already received.
trans-unit.source: Master switch for the public withdrawal flows and customer-facing withdrawal links. Disabling it does not delete or alter withdrawals already received.
trans-unit.target: Pagrindinis viešųjų sutarties atsisakymo procesų ir klientams rodomų nuorodų jungiklis. Išjungus jau gauti atsisakymai neištrinami ir nekeičiami.

trans-unit.resname: Maximum access-link requests associated with the same normalized order reference during 24 hours.
trans-unit.source: Maximum access-link requests associated with the same normalized order reference during 24 hours.
trans-unit.target: Didžiausias prieigos nuorodos užklausų, susijusių su ta pačia normalizuota užsakymo nuoroda, skaičius per 24 valandas.

trans-unit.resname: Maximum access-link requests associated with the same normalized order reference during one hour. This protects the customer mailbox from repeated messages.
trans-unit.source: Maximum access-link requests associated with the same normalized order reference during one hour. This protects the customer mailbox from repeated messages.
trans-unit.target: Didžiausias prieigos nuorodos užklausų, susijusių su ta pačia normalizuota užsakymo nuoroda, skaičius per vieną valandą. Tai saugo kliento pašto dėžutę nuo pasikartojančių laiškų.

trans-unit.resname: Maximum number of plain-text characters accepted in the optional customer note. HTML is not accepted. Recommended default: 2000.
trans-unit.source: Maximum number of plain-text characters accepted in the optional customer note. HTML is not accepted. Recommended default: 2000.
trans-unit.target: Didžiausias paprasto teksto simbolių skaičius neprivalomoje kliento pastaboje. HTML nepriimamas. Rekomenduojama numatytoji reikšmė: 2000.

trans-unit.resname: Maximum order-reference access requests from one pseudonymized IP during 15 minutes. Successful and unsuccessful lookups share the same limit.
trans-unit.source: Maximum order-reference access requests from one pseudonymized IP during 15 minutes. Successful and unsuccessful lookups share the same limit.
trans-unit.target: Didžiausias prieigos pagal užsakymo nuorodą užklausų iš vieno pseudonimizuoto IP adreso skaičius per 15 minučių. Sėkmingoms ir nesėkmingoms paieškoms taikomas tas pats limitas.

trans-unit.resname: Maximum order-reference access requests from one pseudonymized IP during 24 hours. The raw IP address is not stored in the legal withdrawal record.
trans-unit.source: Maximum order-reference access requests from one pseudonymized IP during 24 hours. The raw IP address is not stored in the legal withdrawal record.
trans-unit.target: Didžiausias prieigos pagal užsakymo nuorodą užklausų iš vieno pseudonimizuoto IP adreso skaičius per 24 valandas. Neapdorotas IP adresas nesaugomas teisiniame sutarties atsisakymo įraše.

trans-unit.resname: Maximum total lifetime of a verified guest session even when the customer remains active. Expected range: 15–1440 minutes; recommended default: 120.
trans-unit.source: Maximum total lifetime of a verified guest session even when the customer remains active. Expected range: 15–1440 minutes; recommended default: 120.
trans-unit.target: Didžiausia bendra patvirtinto svečio seanso trukmė, net jei klientas išlieka aktyvus. Tikėtinas intervalas: 15–1440 minučių; rekomenduojama numatytoji reikšmė: 120.

trans-unit.resname: Minimum delay before another access email can be requested for the same order reference. Recommended default: 60 seconds.
trans-unit.source: Minimum delay before another access email can be requested for the same order reference. Recommended default: 60 seconds.
trans-unit.target: Mažiausia pauzė prieš prašant kito prieigos el. laiško tai pačiai užsakymo nuorodai. Rekomenduojama numatytoji reikšmė: 60 sekundžių.

trans-unit.resname: No active shop languages were found.
trans-unit.source: No active shop languages were found.

trans-unit.resname: No data is deleted unless the value is exactly DELETE.
trans-unit.source: No data is deleted unless the value is exactly DELETE.
trans-unit.target: Duomenys neištrinami, nebent reikšmė yra tiksliai DELETE.

trans-unit.resname: Normal module uninstall preserves withdrawal records. This destructive action drops all module tables.
trans-unit.source: Normal module uninstall preserves withdrawal records. This destructive action drops all module tables.
trans-unit.target: Įprastas modulio pašalinimas išsaugo sutarties atsisakymo įrašus. Šis naikinantis veiksmas pašalina visas modulio lenteles.

trans-unit.resname: Number of automatic resend attempts after an acknowledgement email fails. The withdrawal remains valid even when all email attempts fail.
trans-unit.source: Number of automatic resend attempts after an acknowledgement email fails. The withdrawal remains valid even when all email attempts fail.
trans-unit.target: Automatinių pakartotinių bandymų skaičius nepavykus išsiųsti patvirtinimo el. laiško. Sutarties atsisakymas lieka galioti net jei nepavyksta visi el. pašto bandymai.

trans-unit.resname: Opens the Back Office list of received withdrawals, their status, documents, refund records and audit history.
trans-unit.source: Opens the Back Office list of received withdrawals, their status, documents, refund records and audit history.
trans-unit.target: Atidaro Back Office gautų sutarties atsisakymų sąrašą, jų būsenas, dokumentus, grąžinamų sumų įrašus ir audito istoriją.

trans-unit.resname: Optional customer-service phone number shown in the acknowledgement and PDF. It is not used to authenticate a withdrawal.
trans-unit.source: Optional customer-service phone number shown in the acknowledgement and PDF. It is not used to authenticate a withdrawal.
trans-unit.target: Neprivalomas klientų aptarnavimo telefono numeris, rodomas patvirtinime ir PDF. Jis nenaudojamas sutarties atsisakymui autentifikuoti.
Visam laikui ištrinti visus modulio duomenis

trans-unit.resname: Preferred scheduled-maintenance method. It removes expired temporary records, retries queued acknowledgements and processes retention tasks.
trans-unit.source: Preferred scheduled-maintenance method. It removes expired temporary records, retries queued acknowledgements and processes retention tasks.
trans-unit.target: Rekomenduojamas suplanuotos priežiūros būdas. Jis pašalina pasibaigusius laikinuosius įrašus, pakartotinai siunčia eilėje esančius patvirtinimus ir vykdo saugojimo užduotis.

trans-unit.resname: Ready. Required security values and module hooks are available.
trans-unit.source: Ready. Required security values and module hooks are available.
trans-unit.target: Paruošta. Reikiamos saugos reikšmės ir modulio hook'ai prieinami.

trans-unit.resname: Secure online exercise and administration of the consumer right of withdrawal.
trans-unit.source: Secure online exercise and administration of the consumer right of withdrawal.
trans-unit.target: Saugus vartotojo teisės atsisakyti sutarties įgyvendinimas ir administravimas internetu.

trans-unit.resname: Short code used at the beginning of withdrawal references. Use only letters, digits and hyphens; for example WD. Existing withdrawal references are never changed.
trans-unit.source: Short code used at the beginning of withdrawal references. Use only letters, digits and hyphens; for example WD. Existing withdrawal references are never changed.
trans-unit.target: Trumpas kodas sutarties atsisakymo nuorodų pradžioje. Naudokite tik raides, skaitmenis ir brūkšnelius, pavyzdžiui, WD. Esamos nuorodos niekada nekeičiamos.

trans-unit.resname: Some runtime requirements could not be synchronized. Review the PrestaShop logs before public use.
trans-unit.source: Some runtime requirements could not be synchronized. Review the PrestaShop logs before public use.
trans-unit.target: Kai kurių vykdymo reikalavimų nepavyko sinchronizuoti. Prieš viešai naudodami peržiūrėkite „PrestaShop“ žurnalus.

trans-unit.resname: Starts the secure order-reference flow. The customer enters only the public order reference; order and personal data remain hidden until the one-time email link is confirmed.
trans-unit.source: Starts the secure order-reference flow. The customer enters only the public order reference; order and personal data remain hidden until the one-time email link is confirmed.
trans-unit.target: Pradeda saugų procesą pagal užsakymo nuorodą. Klientas įveda tik viešą užsakymo nuorodą; užsakymo ir asmens duomenys lieka paslėpti, kol patvirtinama vienkartinė el. pašto nuoroda.

trans-unit.resname: The default values are deliberately conservative. Increase limits only after reviewing real traffic and abuse logs; lowering them too far can block legitimate consumers.
trans-unit.source: The default values are deliberately conservative. Increase limits only after reviewing real traffic and abuse logs; lowering them too far can block legitimate consumers.
trans-unit.target: Numatytosios reikšmės sąmoningai konservatyvios. Didinkite ribas tik peržiūrėję tikrą srautą ir piktnaudžiavimo žurnalus; per mažos ribos gali blokuoti teisėtus vartotojus.

trans-unit.resname: These values identify the actual seller operating the selected shop. They are stored per shop in multistore and are printed in customer acknowledgements and PDF evidence.
trans-unit.source: These values identify the actual seller operating the selected shop. They are stored per shop in multistore and are printed in customer acknowledgements and PDF evidence.
trans-unit.target: Šios reikšmės identifikuoja faktinį pardavėją, valdantį pasirinktą parduotuvę. Jos saugomos kiekvienai multistore parduotuvei ir spausdinamos kliento patvirtinimuose bei PDF įrodymuose.

trans-unit.resname: This free GitHub module is provided without individual technical support. Installation, configuration, production testing, updates and troubleshooting are available for customers using Joobox PrestaShop Cloud or another paid service explicitly agreed with JOO INTERNET MEDIA LTD.
trans-unit.source: This free GitHub module is provided without individual technical support. Installation, configuration, production testing, updates and troubleshooting are available for customers using Joobox PrestaShop Cloud or another paid service explicitly agreed with JOO INTERNET MEDIA LTD.
trans-unit.target: Šis nemokamas „GitHub“ modulis teikiamas be individualios techninės pagalbos. Diegimas, konfigūravimas, testavimas gamybinėje aplinkoje, naujinimai ir trikčių šalinimas teikiami „Joobox PrestaShop Cloud“ klientams arba pagal kitą mokamą paslaugą, aiškiai suderintą su JOO INTERNET MEDIA LTD.

trans-unit.resname: Type DELETE to confirm permanent data deletion.
trans-unit.source: Type DELETE to confirm permanent data deletion.
trans-unit.target: Įveskite DELETE, kad patvirtintumėte nuolatinį duomenų ištrynimą.

trans-unit.resname: Type the exact word DELETE to remove all withdrawals, documents, audit history, access records and refund records. This action cannot be undone and is not required for an ordinary module update or reinstall.
trans-unit.source: Type the exact word DELETE to remove all withdrawals, documents, audit history, access records and refund records. This action cannot be undone and is not required for an ordinary module update or reinstall.
trans-unit.target: Įveskite tikslų žodį DELETE, kad pašalintumėte visus sutarties atsisakymus, dokumentus, audito istoriją, prieigos ir grąžinimo įrašus. Veiksmo negalima atšaukti ir jis nereikalingas įprastam modulio naujinimui ar diegimui iš naujo.

trans-unit.resname: Unable to verify the latest version from GitHub. Check releases manually.
trans-unit.source: Unable to verify the latest version from GitHub. Check releases manually.
trans-unit.target: Nepavyko patikrinti naujausios versijos „GitHub“. Patikrinkite leidimus rankiniu būdu.

trans-unit.resname: Use these URLs in modules that provide only one URL field for all languages. The entry controller selects the current or preferred shop language and redirects to the localized friendly path.
trans-unit.source: Use these URLs in modules that provide only one URL field for all languages. The entry controller selects the current or preferred shop language and redirects to the localized friendly path.
trans-unit.target: Naudokite šiuos URL moduliuose, kuriuose visoms kalboms pateikiamas tik vienas URL laukas. Įėjimo controller pasirenka dabartinę arba pageidaujamą parduotuvės kalbą ir nukreipia į lokalizuotą aiškų kelią.

trans-unit.resname: Use this only in a disposable test installation.
trans-unit.source: Use this only in a disposable test installation.

trans-unit.resname: Use this URL only when the hosting service cannot run the CLI command. Treat the token as a password: do not publish it, send it by email or place it in public monitoring.
trans-unit.source: Use this URL only when the hosting service cannot run the CLI command. Treat the token as a password: do not publish it, send it by email or place it in public monitoring.
trans-unit.target: Šį URL naudokite tik tada, kai priegloba negali vykdyti CLI komandos. Tokeną laikykite slaptažodžiu: jo neskelbkite, nesiųskite el. paštu ir nedėkite į viešą stebėjimo sistemą.
